header.title: AI access
header.description: Choose what AI can do with your institute’s data, in one place: the assistant inside your admin portal, and AI apps your team connects, such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Every capability appears once, with both side by side. Access always stays inside this institute, and each person reaches only what their role allows.

capabilities.title: What AI can do
capabilities.description: Set each area to Off, View or Edit for the in-product assistant and for AI apps. Open a row to see exactly what it allows and to switch single capabilities on or off.

door.outsidePlanHint: Your plan doesn’t include this. Anything saved for it is kept as it is.
door.assistantEdits: The assistant only proposes these changes. Nothing is applied until the person presses Confirm.

scope.label: Settings for
scope.everyoneHint: Applies to every staff role. Pick a role to give it extra capabilities on top.
scope.roleHint: Everything {{role}} has: what everyone has plus its own extras. What’s on for everyone is marked and can only be turned off under Everyone.
scope.customizeAssistant: Customize the assistant for this role
scope.customizeMcp: Customize AI apps for this role
scope.notAllowedMcp: This role can’t connect AI apps. Add it under Who can connect first.
scope.presetApplied: Suggested set applied. Click Save settings to keep it.

mcpOff: The MCP server is off, so AI apps can’t connect yet. You can still choose what they’ll be able to do.

section.mcpDescription: Turn the MCP server on, choose who may connect, and share the connection details.
